title: Three light beings at the foot of his ICU bed during COVID sepsis

tellings.quote: And at one point in one of those nights, I'm just laying there by myself and all of a sudden light entities come to the foot of my bed.

tellings.difference: The telling's metadata puts it during a cancer illness, not COVID sepsis, and gives no number of beings and no date.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Brent's own encounter with light beings at the foot of his bed while he was gravely ill.

plain: Lying alone one night in a hospital intensive care unit, gravely ill with sepsis (a body-wide reaction to infection) from COVID around 2020 or 2021, a Hollywood writer named Brent Friedman says that "all of a sudden light entities come to the foot of my bed." Friedman tells this himself as the one who saw it, and if it happened as he says, it would be a meeting with something beyond ordinary life at the edge of death. In a later conversation with Michels he speaks again of "watching light beings come to the foot of my bed" on his deathbed, though that telling places it during a cancer illness and gives no number of beings and no date.
